description: Header file defining the Store2 class implementing various storage interfaces using SQLite, including database management, data operations, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin for SQLite storage.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: Main class implementing IStore2, IStoreCache, IStoreInspector, and IStoreLimit interfaces for SQLite-based persistent storage with database integrity, backup, and notification features.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class for dispatching value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes temporary directory corruption.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs database integrity verification and marks corruption.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the SQLite database, creating necessary tables and triggers.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if system time is synchronized (platform-specific).

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for store events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store with optional TTL, notifying observers.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes SQLite cache and syncs data.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespace names.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Gets size of each namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Retrieves storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of a value change.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Logs SQLite errors.
